_comment: COD confirmation that ends on what happened to the ORDER (rollout phase 21; docs/crm/workflow-rollout/21-goal-conditions-and-tags.md). Door: orders/create for a cash-on-delivery order, one run per order (key id) -> hold 30m -> call -> wait 1d. The goal is an orders/updated tier WITH conditions: fulfillment_state is "fulfilled", keyed to this order -> goal_met; orders/cancelled -> withdrawn. Shopify fires orders/updated for every edit, our own tag writes included, so without the `where` the first echo would end the run. A tier with a `where` must carry a `key`: the walker re-checks it at every claim on the order's NEWEST letter (every edit carries the whole order), so a fulfilment consumed before the run existed still ends it.
